name: EU Long-Term Resident Status

requirements.blocker_text: 5 years of legal and continuous residence immediately preceding the application. Absences up to 12 consecutive months (not exceeding 18 months total across the 5-year period) for specific/exceptional reasons do not break continuity.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of continuous legal residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Resources above EUR 855/month for a single-person household, plus EUR 285/month per dependent, assessed at the time of application, considering the nature and regularity of the resources.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 years' continuous legal residence
Proof of income meeting the household threshold

outcome.duration_length: indefinite status; permit duration not specified at tier-1 precision in this pass

sources.title: European Migration Network Belgium (national contact point coordinated by IBZ/FPS Home Affairs) -- Long-Term Resident Status in the EU: Belgium's 5-year residence requirement, EUR 855/EUR 285 income thresholds, absence rules, no integration requirement

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Belgium). Notably, Belgium does NOT impose a language or civics integration requirement for this status (explicitly confirmed by the source) -- unlike several other countries in this dataset (e.g. Iceland, Finland) where permanent residence carries a language bar. The physical permit card's own validity/renewal period was not specified at tier-1 precision -- flagged as a gap.
